today_in_history_posts.title: BIP- & SLIP-0039 -- better multi-language support
today_in_history_posts.summary: - BIP-0039 mnemonics are language dependent, potentially causing issues for users who prefer non-English words.  - Guo suggests using entropy-based mnemonic codes and allowing third-party translation tools for language flexibility.  - He proposes decimal representation for seeds and seeks community feedback on possible solutions.

today_in_history_posts.title: RFC: simplifications and suggestions on open/accept limits.
today_in_history_posts.summary: - Gert-Jaap advises against removing htlc_minimum_msat, emphasizing its protective function against trimmed HTLCs.  - He recommends setting a higher default above dust limits and varying dust definitions based on fees.  - Rusty supports chain-dependent minimum_depth but opposes opt-outs for parts below 1000 msat, citing practical issues.

today_in_history_posts.title: Segwit Ephemeral Anchors
today_in_history_posts.summary: - Ephemeral Anchors enable key-less outputs, but legacy scripts expose them to transaction ID malleability.  - Using wsh(OP_TRUE) is inefficient, adding extra bytes and revealing redundant witness scripts.  - The proposal recommends using undefined witness programs for efficient spending, requiring relay policy changes.
